name: The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory

bagPolicy.summary: Bags must be clear and smaller than 12” x 6” x 12”. Small clutch bags, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6” x 9” are allowed and do not need to be clear.
allowed: CLEAR plastic/vinyl tote bags no larger than 12” x 6” x 12”
Small clutch bags, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6” x 9”
prohibited: Large Bags / Backpacks / Luggage / Computer Bags / Camera Bags
Chairs of ANY kind including Lawn Chairs
Outside food or drinks – except factory sealed water
Any other item that may pose a threat
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General parking is in Urban Towers Garage. VIP parking is in Toyota Music Factory Garage. Reserve through ParkTMF. Overnight parking is prohibited.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory offers a variety of food options including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas, and Koko's Bavarian sausages and pretzels. General concessions include popcorn, nachos, and a selection of drinks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking for general admission is in The Urban Towers Parking Garage, and VIP accessible parking is in the Toyota Music Factory Parking Garage; a visible state-issued placard or ADA plate is required and space is limited, so arrive early. The main entrance and Toyota Lounge are accessible, and the accessible lawn area has a designated pathway, with elevators at the front of the building and in the East Plaza.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Your original ticket does not allow re-entry. Returning after leaving requires a new ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens at noon on show days. Call 214-978-4888 for help.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: GA ticket holders use the main entrance between Grimaldi's Pizzeria and Kitchen101. Toyota Lounge ticket holders use the VIP entrance beside the Box Office, facing Las Colinas Blvd. Both entrances are accessible, and guest services can help when you arrive.
